name: HippoPay Payments with Creem for WooCommerce
author: hippoplugins

sections.description:
Unlock seamless and secure payment processing for your online store with HippoPay Payments with Creem for WooCommerce. This official integration connects your WooCommerce store to the Creem payment gateway, enabling you to accept a wide variety of payment methods quickly and safely.

Creem is the complete all-in-one platform built specifically for software companies, SaaS, Indie Hackers, and digital creators. Whether you are selling digital products, license keys, subscriptions, or physical goods, providing a frictionless checkout experience is critical for boosting conversion rates.

Why Choose Creem?

  • Low, Transparent Fees: Save up to 40% on fees with a flat rate of 3.9% + 40¢ per successful transaction. No surprise add-ons, no gotchas.
  • Better International Rates: Process global payments more cost-effectively compared to legacy providers, keeping more of your hard-earned revenue.
  • Merchant of Record (MoR): Let Creem handle the hard stuff. Global tax compliance and paperwork are managed automatically, so you can focus on building your product.
  • Global Payment Methods: Accept Cards, SEPA, mobile wallets, and more, all out-of-the-box.
  • Stablecoin Payouts: Enjoy the ultimate flexibility with fast, secure payouts via stablecoins anywhere in the world.
  • Customer Portal: Provide a beautiful self-service portal where customers can manage their payments, download receipts, and handle billing securely.
  • Smart Revenue Splits: Auto-distribute payments and intelligently split revenue with partners or team members instantly.
  • Business AI Assistant: Get instant insights, revenue forecasts, and customer intelligence with plain English queries directly in your dashboard.

Key Plugin Features

  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration: Effortlessly connect your store to Creem.io without writing a single line of code.
  • Checkout Blocks Compatible: Fully supports both the classic WooCommerce shortcode checkout and the modern, conversion-optimized WooCommerce Checkout Blocks natively.
  • Secure Off-Site Checkout: Offload the burden of PCI compliance by directing customers to Creem’s highly secure, hosted payment pages.
  • Real-Time Order Updates: Automated webhook integration ensures your WooCommerce order statuses are updated instantly as soon as a payment is verified.
  • Sandbox Testing Mode: Safely test your entire checkout flow using test API keys before going live to real customers.

Supported Payment Methods

  • Visa
  • Mastercard
  • American Express
  • Apple Pay
  • Google Pay
  • Bancontact
  • Cartes Bancaires
  • EPS
  • IDEAL
  • Link
  • MobilePay

Provide your customers with a fast, secure, and modern payment experience today with HippoPay Payments and Creem!

External Services

This plugin connects to the Creem payment API to process payments.

The service is used to:
– create payment requests
– process transactions
– verify payment status

Data sent to the service may include:
– order information
– transaction amount
– customer billing details

Data is sent when a customer places an order during checkout.

Service provider:
Creem

Terms of Service:
https://creem.io/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://creem.io/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and enable “Creem”.
  4. Enter your Test API Keys and Webhook Secret from your Creem dashboard.
